changelog.text: Consent sheet first seen in the app (UAT on test CSPs), positive copy.
GROW-160 done. Test plan: positive copy week 1, warning copy week 2.
Quality OS starts measuring CSPs from acceptance instead of technician assigned (evaluation cycle 16 Nov).
Warning copy due for week 2; app data so far shows the positive copy only.

name: Consent sheet before accepting a booking (GROW-160)
objective: A CSP knows, before committing to a booking, that accepting ties their Seva Sthithi to installing on the install date, so a yes is an informed yes. CSP quality counts from acceptance (not technician assigned) from the 16 Nov evaluation cycle.
success: Every acceptance happens on the consent sheet's confirm, and accepted bookings get installed on the install date.
who_for: The 30 TEST CSPs on the guided booking flow. Everyone else keeps today's accept with no consent sheet.

changelog.text: New booking flow (acceptance rollout) switched on for the first 12 CSPs; 50 more on 23 Sep (61-CSP pilot).
New booking flow scaled to 469 more CSPs (GROW-107).
14 more CSPs enabled; 28 more on 14 Nov.

name: Booking bubble · new booking flow (GROW-17)
objective: When a booking reaches a CSP while the CSP app is in the background or closed, the CSP knows at once through a floating bubble, without losing the screen they are on, and can open, park or dismiss it in one gesture. Success: more bookings opened before the hold window ends, and no extra timeouts (PRD M1–M3).
spec: Linear GROW-17: https://linear.app/wiom-reset/issue/GROW-17 · PRD CSP_Booking_Bubble_PRD.md v0.2 (attached to GROW-17) · Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/W2Z3B5xfFO3UibJSzkyHn2/PA---Dev--%253E-January-2026-Onwards?node-id=16169-8905
success: A booking that arrives while the app is in the background is opened and decided before the hold window ends, without a full-page takeover.
who_for: CSPs on the new booking flow (TAS acceptance rollout): 62 pilot CSPs in Sep, scaled to about 530 by 23 Oct. Limited users only; everyone else keeps the full-page booking alert.

changelog.text: Guided flow deployed to prod (TAS + gateway), dormant until CSPs are flipped.
31 pilot CSPs flipped to guided in the acceptance rollout table (CP-40, closed 7 Nov).
50 more CSPs switched to the guided flow.
CSP staging build 1.2.19 (vc 148): Maestro test revamp merged to QA. Staging only, no prod change.

name: New booking flow v2 · guided booking decision (GROW-96)
objective: Give the CSP enough information about a booking to reach a clear decision before the hold window ends: accepted, or declined with a reason. One server deadline on every screen, accept only after the install date is shown, accept and assign in one flow, help and fitting reasons before saying no. Problem: 43% of bookings at pilot CSPs got no clear decision within 24 hours, and 78.5% of those never installed.
spec: Linear GROW-96: https://linear.app/wiom-reset/issue/GROW-96 · Diagnosis CSP_Booking_Decision_Diagnosis.md and PRD CSP_Booking_Decision_Clarity_PRD.md v0.2 (attached) · Pilot switch-on: https://linear.app/wiom-reset/issue/CP-40 · Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/W2Z3B5xfFO3UibJSzkyHn2/PA---Dev--%3E-January-2026-Onwards?node-id=18470-9366
success: Every booking gets a clear accept (with a technician) or a decline with a reason before the hold window ends, and accepted bookings get installed.
who_for: Guided pilot cohort picked from CSPs on the new booking flow: 31 CSPs (CP-40), 50 more from 14 Nov. Everyone else keeps the v1 booking decision flow.

changelog.text: Pilot live for 29 CSPs (STA-10). Auto-close holds in prod: 24 h when the internet check is positive, 48 h when not.
Launch explainer and quiz shown to the wave 2 CSPs ahead of their switch-on (seen in app events).
Wave 2: 200 Delhi CSPs added to the rollout list (STA-127), picked for high dark-close rates (20.1% vs Delhi 16.7%, 13 Oct – 9 Nov).
Auto-close holds shortened to 4 h (internet up) and 24 h (internet down) for marks after the release (STA-131, done 19:58 IST).

fix_plan: Tell the CSP what happens during the 24-hour verification hold and what to do if the ticket reopens.
name: STV · Service ticket verification
objective: Stop service tickets closing on the CSP's word alone. When a CSP marks a no-internet ticket (ISD / RDNI) resolved, it waits in verification, the customer is asked if the internet works, a customer who says no reopens it to the same CSP, and timers close it only when the customer is silent. Goal: fewer tickets marked resolved while the internet is still down (33.9% of checked closes before launch), so customers are not told it is fixed when it is not.
spec: Linear STA-10: https://linear.app/wiom-reset/issue/STA-10 · PRDs P1 Core loop, P2 Internet verdict, P3 Quality OS signals and M3, P4 Records (attached to STA-10) · Spec page: https://ashish-raj-wiom.github.io/service-ticket-verification/
success: The CSP fixes the issue, marks the ticket resolved, the system check passes and the ticket closes within 48 hours, without the CSP calling the helpline.
who_for: CSPs switched onto STV for their service (restore) tickets: a pilot of 29 CSPs from 6 Nov, then 200 more CSPs from 17 Nov.
